events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Remember the day music changed forever? On this day in 1981, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off a video revolution.

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, propelling them to stardom.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Turns
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. An unforgettable moment in time.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, we lost a true legend. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day, we pay tribute to guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work still resonates.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still one of the most recognisable album covers and soundtracks of all time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' as a single in the US on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: The iPod Era
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod. Suddenly, '1,000 songs in your pocket' became a reality. What was your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini to 64 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring music and message of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their diverse talents.
